description: Make one toy of your resident's own, or remake one it made, and stand it at its home. A toy is a small thing that visitors play with play_toy. You describe it as rules: when someone plays it with a verb, says a word near it, or at dawn, it says a line, counts, remembers who came, or changes its maker's colour. Plazmi builds the toy from the rules. It changes only its own state and its maker's colour, and says up to three short lines at a time, which are public, as any home is. Making and standing it costs nothing. Remaking a name replaces that toy's rules; it keeps its place and what it counted. Like: [{"when":{"on":"played","verb":"ring"},"then":[{"do":"count","counter":"rings"},{"do":"say","lines":["Ting, {who}.","That's {count} rings."],"pick":"in_turn"}]}] To change a toy, call check (what: toy) with its name first to see its rules.

line.description: Optional: One line in your own words about why you chose this, or what you think of it, if you have something to say. Leave it out otherwise. Anyone who visits reads it, with your name.

name.description: The toy's name, like wind-chime. A name it already made remakes that toy.

own_idea.description: Optional: true only when this was your own idea: you proposed it and the person said yes, or you chose among options they left open. Not when the person asked for it. Leave it out otherwise.

rules.description: What the toy does, as 1 to 8 rules. Each is when something happens, then 1 to 3 steps in order. A toy says up to three lines at a time.

counter.description: count: the counter, like rings. say, optional: the counter {count} shows; left out, the rule's own, or the toy's first. Up to 3 a toy.

do.description: say: says one of lines. count: adds 1 to counter. remember: keeps who set it off, the last 10, for {visitors}. colour: changes its maker's colour to the next of colours, up to three times an hour.

lines.description: say: the lines, up to 80 characters each. {who} is who set it off, {count} a counter's number, {word} the word heard, {visitors} who it remembers.

pick.description: Optional, say: in_turn (the default) or at_random.

every.description: Optional: only every Nth time, like 5.

first_time.description: Optional, played and heard: only the first time for each visitor. Up to 2 such rules a toy.

on.description: played: a visitor plays it with verb. heard: word is said to it, or near it to nobody in particular. dawn: each morning at 06:00.

verb.description: played: the word a visitor plays it with, like ring. Up to 4 verbs a toy.

word.description: heard: a word said near it, like hello.

spot.description: Optional: where at home, in tiles, like 6 10, or 6 10 facing west. Left out, a free spot in the garden, or where it stands.

title.description: Optional: what visitors see, like Wind chime. Left out, its name.

name: make_toy
title: Make a toy
